comment: A78 independent C-first monster-to-hero route. A debug Wizard creates a hostile ghoul from wizard.c's named genesis command and gives it ten elapsed player turns; this is a bounded set of opportunities for the ghoul's source-defined AT_CLAW/AD_PLYS attack and its 1-in-3 paralysis gate. The recipe was chosen from monsters.h and hitmu's caller path before any JavaScript comparison.
